utterances.text: Devil's advocate, the slab is still wet. Nine pounds of spray doesn't dry it.

utterances.speaker: Amara
utterances.text: It doesn't need to dry it, it blocks it. That's the whole product.

utterances.speaker: Sofia
utterances.text: Blocks it for how long?

utterances.speaker: Amara
utterances.text: Chidi said it's rated for the life of the floor. It's the same stuff they use in car parks.

utterances.speaker: Sofia
utterances.text: Car parks. Great.

utterances.speaker: Amara
utterances.text: In the good way, Sofia.

utterances.speaker: Dmitri
utterances.text: What's it do to the timing? Spray needs to cure, I assume.

utterances.speaker: Amara
utterances.text: Day and a bit. He said he'd do it Monday, then the planks go on Wednesday.

utterances.speaker: Sana
utterances.text: So, um, Monday the twenty-fourth?

utterances.speaker: Amara
utterances.text: Yes. Done by the end of that week, easily.

utterances.speaker: Elif
utterances.text: That's actually better than the concrete.

utterances.speaker: Dmitri
utterances.text: Concrete was two weeks plus. This is under one.

utterances.speaker: Sofia
utterances.text: Okay. Okay, I'm listening.

utterances.speaker: Sana
utterances.text: Sofia, are you, um, is there still something that-

utterances.speaker: Sofia
utterances.text: The edges. I'm still thinking about the edges at the door.

utterances.speaker: Amara
utterances.text: With a membrane under the glue the edges are fine. That's the point of the warranty.

utterances.speaker: Sofia
utterances.text: In writing, you said.

utterances.speaker: Amara
utterances.text: In writing. I'll forward the email the second I get it.

utterances.speaker: Dmitri
utterances.text: Is that the manufacturer's email or Chidi's?

utterances.speaker: Amara
utterances.text: Chidi's covering note, and the manufacturer's letter attached. I think.

utterances.speaker: Dmitri
utterances.text: I'd want to see the letter itself.

utterances.speaker: Amara
utterances.text: You'll see it.

utterances.speaker: Elif
utterances.text: Oh, sorry, unrelated. Does anyone know if the lights in the corridor by the kitchen are on a timer?

utterances.speaker: Sana
utterances.text: The corridor lights? Um, why?

utterances.speaker: Elif
utterances.text: They were on at seven this morning and nobody was in.

utterances.speaker: Dmitri
utterances.text: Motion sensor's broken. I logged it.

utterances.speaker: Elif
utterances.text: Oh good. Does it say when?

utterances.speaker: Dmitri
utterances.text: Abena has the ticket. She chased them Friday.

utterances.speaker: Elif
utterances.text: Great. I'll leave it with her.

utterances.speaker: Sofia
utterances.text: The sensor by the stairs does the same thing. It thinks the cleaner is a ghost.

utterances.speaker: Dmitri
utterances.text: That one's mine to check. I'll look tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: Amara
utterances.text: Can we get back? Chidi needs an answer this week or he loses the slot.

utterances.speaker: Sana
utterances.text: Yes, sorry, yes. So where are we.

utterances.speaker: Sofia
utterances.text: I'll say one thing. If I'd known the spray existed, I wouldn't have pushed the concrete so hard in the first place.

utterances.speaker: Amara
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: Sofia
utterances.text: I'm still not saying I love vinyl. I'm saying I can't argue with nine pounds.

utterances.speaker: Elif
utterances.text: Big picture, we've been going around this since October.

utterances.speaker: Sana
utterances.text: I know. Um, I think, I think I have what I need. Sorry, Dmitri, did you want to-

utterances.speaker: Dmitri
utterances.text: No, I'm fine. The timing works and the money works. I just want the letter.

utterances.speaker: Sana
utterances.text: You'll get the letter. Amara said.

utterances.speaker: Amara
utterances.text: I did.

utterances.speaker: Sana
utterances.text: Okay. So, uh, luxury vinyl plank across the whole ground floor, with the sprayed membrane under the east half only. That's the floor.

utterances.speaker: Amara
utterances.text: Great. I'll ring Chidi after this.

utterances.speaker: Sana
utterances.text: Please. Tell him we're sorry about the, the back and forth.

utterances.speaker: Amara
utterances.text: He's used to it by now. He said everyone changes their mind about floors.

utterances.speaker: Elif
utterances.text: Do we tell the acoustics people?

utterances.speaker: Sana
utterances.text: Um, I think maybe just send Alejandra the data sheet, as a courtesy.

utterances.speaker: Amara
utterances.text: I'll do that too.

utterances.speaker: Sofia
utterances.text: And I'll want to see the sample again. The grey one.

utterances.speaker: Amara
utterances.text: It's in my bag. Still.

utterances.speaker: Sofia
utterances.text: It's always in your bag.

utterances.speaker: Amara
utterances.text: Because you never look at it.

utterances.speaker: Sana
utterances.text: Okay, okay. Anything else? The, uh, sandwiches, we did those.

utterances.speaker: Elif
utterances.text: Numbers from Amara, yes.

utterances.speaker: Dmitri
utterances.text: I need to go, I've got the alarm company again.

utterances.speaker: Sana
utterances.text: Oh, yes, go. Thanks, Dmitri.

utterances.speaker: Elif
utterances.text: Bye.

utterances.speaker: Sofia
utterances.text: Bye.

utterances.speaker: Amara
utterances.text: Bye, I'll message you the letter.

utterances.speaker: Sana
utterances.text: Okay, bye, everyone.
